ordered.title: Review guidelines
ordered.description: We publish all genuine reviews - positive or negative - as long as they:

items: Come from a verified customer who used our platform
Do not contain offensive language or personal attacks
Are relevant to the service we provide

blocks.text: We do not delete negative reviews.
We believe honest feedback - including criticism - makes our platform more trustworthy.
When a negative review appears, we:

items: Investigate the issue (if the customer provides enough detail)
Reply professionally, acknowledging any legitimate concerns

blocks.text: Example response to a negative review: “Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear about your experience. A member of our team will be in touch to understand what went wrong and how we can improve.”
